arxiv-2509-18862.description: Abstract With the rapid advancement of large language model technology, there is growing interest in whether multi-feature approaches can significantly improve AI text detection beyond what single neural models achieve. arxiv-2511-19080.title: Towards Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Forgery-aware Audio-Visual Adaptation: A Variational Bayesian Approach
arxiv-2511-19080.creator: Fan Nie, Jiangqun Ni, Jian Zhang, Bin Zhang, Weizhe Zhang, Bin Li
arxiv-2511-19080.description: Abstract The widespread application of AIGC contents has brought not only unprecedented opportunities, but also potential security concerns, e.g., audio-visual deepfakes. Typically, the audio-visual correlation learning could expose subtle cross-modal inconsistencies, e.g., audio-visual misalignment, which serve as crucial clues in deepfake detection.

pmc-10647316.title: Vacuum Ultraviolet (VUV) Light Photofunctionalization to Induce Human Oral Fibroblast Transmigration on Zirconia

pmc-10647316.description: Soft tissue adhesion and sealing around dental and maxillofacial implants, related prosthetic components, and crowns are a clinical imperative to prevent adverse outcomes of periodontitis and periimplantitis. Zirconia is often used to fabricate implant components and crowns. Here, we hypothesized that UV treatment of zirconia would induce unique behaviors in fibroblasts that favor the establishment of a soft tissue seal.

pmc-11337634.title: Association between gynecologic cancer and Alzheimer’s disease: a bidirectional mendelian randomization study
pmc-11337634.creator: Di Cao, Shaobo Zhang, Yini Zhang, Ming Shao, Qiguang Yang, Ping Wang
pmc-11337634.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) manifests with a higher rate of occurrence in women. Previous epidemiological studies have suggested a potential association between AD and gynecological cancers, but the causal relationship between them remains unclear. This study aims to explore the causal link between 12 types of gynecological cancers and AD using a bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) approach.

pmc-12785265.title: LpMAX2 Is a Strigolactone/Karrikin Signaling Component in Perennial Ryegrass (Lolium perenne L.)

pmc-12785265.description: Perennial ryegrass is a widely cultivated cool-season forage and turf grass species whose growth and development are limited by drought and high temperature. pmc-12962875.title: Case Report of Acute Severe Hyponatremia Induced by Desmopressin Administration During Chemotherapy

pmc-12962875.description: Patients undergoing chemotherapy are prone to developing hyponatremia due to insufficient oral intake because of nausea and vomiting, administration of large volumes of intravenous fluids, syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion induced by chemotherapeutic agents, adrenal insufficiency, and drug interactions. We included all products and processes in each diagnostic strategy.

pmc-13262949.title: RECOMBINE identifies recurrent composite markers of cell types and states
pmc-13262949.creator: Xubin Li, Justin Nguyen, Anil Korkut
pmc-13262949.description: Biological function is mediated by the hierarchical organization of cell types and states within tissue ecosystems. Here, we present RECOMBINE, an algorithm that identifies recurrent composite marker sets to define hierarchical cell identities.
